datasets.title: Global Community Water Model (Global CWatM) - Rural population future
datasets.description: Percentage of total population in a country or region that lives in rural areas for future data. Data is available as global grids at a 30 arc-seconds resolution from Global CWatM. The share of rural population was calculated by dividing the rural by the total population counts.
